defects.source_says: The held text dates the order May 21, 2012 (heading 'Executive Order 13613 of May 21, 2012' and signature 'May 21, 2012'); the claim's own signing_date, judgment_reason ('operated when the order was signed on 2012-05-21') and research_rationale ('its own performance on 2012-05-21') give 2012-05-21. A first end three years before the order existed is impossible and contradicts the claim's own reasons.

reasoning: Identity (EO 13613, May 21, 2012, Obama, 77 FR 31155, Commerce order of succession) agrees with the held FR text and the OFR catalog. Hashes and every quoted span match. The inventory is complete. No held source amends, revokes or supersedes the order: the OFR catalog note records only its revocation of EO 13242, the edge table and the held-text search show no later citer, and the dossier chain is empty, so the yes status and the operative predicates for sections 1, 2 and 4 are supported on the original-plus-bounded-search basis through 2026-10-14. Savings treatment is accurate and the searches are honestly described. The claim fails on section 3: its first_end.date is 2009-05-21, which predates the order and contradicts the 2012-05-21 date stated in the same clause's judgment_reason, the signing_date and the research_rationale. A wrong first-end date is a disqualifying defect even though the outcome (yes) appears correct. Non-blocking observation: the sec. 3 original_operative_text span includes the page 1 printer's footer and page 2 running head; the bytes match, but a corrected claim should trim it.
